description: resolve.py's resolve_all() (skills/earn/pm-trade/resolve.py:38-77) is the module that implements the fix for iteration-2's CRITICAL FIND-001 -- it is the only code path that ever turns a decide.py 'open' row into a 'resolved' row with pnl_usdc, which is the sole input gate.py needs to ever produce PM_PAPER_PASS=1. It has ZERO test coverage: neither test_lib.py nor test_strategy.py imports resolve or exercises resolve_all in any way. Corroborating disk evidence: __pycache__/ has no resolve.cpython-314.pyc, meaning resolve.py has never even been imported in this venv, let alone tested.
